name: Tiefling
printedArtCredit: Emily Fiegenschuh, A tiefling rogue, p. 16.
sourceDistinctions: The p. 16 player traits give Darkness once daily at caster level equal to character level. Level adjustment increases ECL, not character level.
The 3.5 spell creates shadowy illumination and 20% concealment, including against darkvision. Concealment blocks sneak attack.
Cold, electricity, and fire resistance are each 5. Native Outsider is the base type and the 5e profiles retain their own rules.
No Tiefling correction appears in the November 2004 errata. The separate Monster Manual warrior is not part of this profile.
portraitForm: Sella Cinderlock, an original Tiefling Rogue
